_about: The Anomalous Force Protein (weight_booster, 339) in a pocket makes its carrier's gun-stock hits to a hand lethal (the owner, 2026-11-05): the booster's parameter spot_enemy_traps_modifier 1 (player modifier 47, which no 0.26g code reads) is in its carrier's kit while carried (survarium::booster 0x33F690 / 0x33F990), and exe patch 108 deals a blunt hit on an arm or forearm zone by such an attacker as lethal (docs/notes/force-protein-hand-kill.md).
